entries.title: Ezra 5:1
segments:
Prophesied unto the Jews; exhorting them to proceed with the building of the temple. 
 
When the people of God needlessly neglect his work, he will reprove them, and by his ministers and his providence convince them of their sin, and lead them to engage anew in the discharge of their duty.

entries.title: Ezra 5:3
segments: Governor on this side the river; of the Assyrian provinces west of the Euphrates.

entries.title: Ezra 5:4
segments: What are the names; this question it seems was put by Tatnai the governor, to the Jews.

entries.title: Ezra 5:5
segments: Those who attempt, in dependence on God, to do what they can for the promotion of his cause, will find him ready to assist them; and with him for their guide and helper, the efforts of enemies to stop their progress will be in vain.

entries.title: Ezra 5:11
segments: Open and frank acknowledgment of our attachment to God and his cause, of our sins against him, and of his justice in our punishment, is the surest way of securing his continued smiles.

entries.title: Ezra 5:16
segments: Since that time even until now; that is, in process of building: as much as to say, It was commenced then and is not yet finished.

entries.title: Ezra 5:17
segments: A true statement of facts as they are, will ordinarily show the integrity of the people of God, and that in those transactions in which the wicked have most opposed them, they have acted with fairness, uprightness, and fidelity.
